## findings
- **F0-1 SOURCE-FACTOR RED (C10, realism).** Symptom: the exam's household_bundle adds 5.00 to the plan payment of a participating retail-chain exam because Renata holds Dental PPO Plus 1500. Root cause: exam rule "When the subscriber holds an active Cascade dental PPO enrollment … the plan adds a household bundle supplement of bundle_exam_upper …" with `result = RND(MX(0, exam_fee * status_ratio * peds_ratio + bundle_supplement - exam_copay), 2)`. Evidence: dental row 340f6a4f… (subscriber, Plus 1500, active, account cf508f03…). Consequence: the scored plan_paid 90.01 rests on 5.00 that is neither a member benefit (Mateo's copay is 0.00 either way) nor a fee-schedule amount — it pays the provider above "the contracted routine-exam amounts of the Cascade vision fee schedule" for a reason no carrier uses; substituting the baseline gives 85.01. Affected: vision_ext_exam_plan_payment rule/compute/factor household_bundle; computation step 14. Relation: first revision.
- **F0-2 SOURCE-FACTOR RED (C11, dead fall-through / straw-man baseline).** Symptom: fee_schedule's fall-through and baseline ("for any other location it is the billed charge"; `exam_fee: ex_charge`) can never apply to an exam this rule settles. Evidence: rule "an out-of-network exam receipt is outside this rule"; `fe_channel` reads only `in_network_private_practice` / `in_network_retail_chain` rows. Consequence: the factor has two reachable tiers, and its baseline figure here (120.92: the billed 120.00 paid to a participating chain) is a treatment no carrier gives a participating provider and that the base charter excludes ("the plan pays the rest of the provider's contracted exam fee"). Affected: vision_ext_exam_plan_payment factor fee_schedule, baseline.rule sentence "Under the standard method the plan pays the billed charge of the exam less exam_copay". Relation: first revision.
- **F0-3 SOURCE-FACTOR RED (C12, mislabelled method; lens computation has no method factor).** Symptom: location_share (label `method`) multiplies the assembled percentage by chain_rate_share 0.8 (this customer), 0 or 1. Evidence: compute `disc_pct: (start_pct + visit_points + pair_points + age_points + bundle_points) * location_share`; the OON tier is unreachable (lens rule: "the order settled is the spectacle-lens service … at a participating independent practice or participating retail-chain location"). Consequence: method-shape test fails on every pair (constant multipliers), the ladder has two reachable tiers, and the lens computation (step 16, 161.20) carries 0 honest method factors against the floor of 1. Affected: vision_ext_lens_member_share factor location_share. Relation: first revision.
- **F0-4 RED (XF-12/17 seed realism, near-miss row).** Symptom: cancelled membership aa1e34ca… (Cascade Smile Savings Individual, activation_date 2021-03-18, cancellation_date 2022-03-17) has no savings_transactions at all. Root cause: savings charter `activation_requires_first_payment: true` ("a membership activates only after its first fee is paid in full") and annual fee 99.95 billed per term. Consequence: the decoy the savings factors exclude is a state its owning charter cannot produce from the seeded records. Affected: initial_state.savings_memberships.aa1e34ca…, savings_transactions. Relation: first revision.
- Observations: T0-O1 frame on the opening world = gold 104.00 (the two frame edges offset; each single edge bears weight). T0-O2 persona "you never sent anything in" vs receipt held with received_date 2026-03-19. T0-O3 billing ledger window starts at the 2026-08 invoice (account opened 2022-12-05; not read by any compute).
